Gold, Silver Prices and Rupee May See Volatility Amid Iran Tensions

Gold and silver prices, along with the Indian rupee, may experience volatility in the coming week. This potential fluctuation is attributed to heightened tensions between the US and Iran. The geopolitical situation is prompting caution among merchants and investors, influencing currency and commodity markets.
